g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure PCI DSS payments platform with a hub firewall, private AKS and Managed HSM tokenisation

g.title: None.None.Node.31
g.text: A merchant's checkout posts the card payment over TLS
Application Gateway's WAF inspects it and sends it to the payment API on the private AKS cluster
The API tokenises the card number with a key that never leaves Managed HSM
and stores the token and transaction in Azure SQL with Always Encrypted
The authorisation request leaves through Azure Firewall in the hub, which allows only the card networks
The card network authorises it over mutual TLS
Each captured payment is queued for settlement
The settlement function batches the queue at cut-off
and writes an audit record to immutable Blob Storage
then sends the settlement file to the acquirer through the hub firewall
